title: SGX Mainboard Listing Rules 711A and 711B (sustainability report, climate-related disclosures)
citation: SGX-ST Listing Manual, Mainboard Rules, rr 711A, 711B
evidence: rulebook.sgx.com/rulebook/mainboard-rules, rr 711A and 711B text ends: "Added on 20 July 2016 and amended on 1 January 2022 and 1 January 2026."
notes: Rules 711A and 711B were added 20 July 2016 and amended 1 January 2022, 1 January 2025 (climate-related disclosures, r 711B(1)(aa)) and 1 January 2026. Phasing by tier is on the ACRA requirements timeline (https://www.acra.gov.sg/regulations/sustainability-reporting/requirements-timeline/, opened 2026-11-02, last updated 27 July 2026): all listed companies report Scope 1 and 2 from FY starting 1 January 2025; STI constituents also report other ISSB-based climate disclosures from FY2025 and Scope 3 from FY2026; non-STI issuers of market cap S$1bn and above from FY2028, below S$1bn from FY2030. Exchange rules, not statute. Link only: SGX copyright, terms unread.

title: SGX Mainboard Practice Note 7.6 Sustainability Reporting Guide (climate-related disclosures)
